about.desc: A desktop app that shows the terminal sessions of many AI coding agents as a pixel office scene

delete.title: Delete character
delete.warning: The running session will be terminated.

restart.title: Restart terminal
restart.warning: The running session ends and the scrollback is cleared.

resume.title: Resume previous session
resume.warning: The running session ends and the scrollback is cleared.
resume.body: End {{name}}’s current session and resume the previous Claude session?

terminate.title: Close terminal
terminate.warning: The running session ends. The character waits in the break room, and clicking them starts a new session.

botStart.title: Start bot mode
botStart.warning: On a bare shell the bot’s instructions are typed in as shell commands and error out. Start claude in the terminal first, then turn the bot on.
botStart.body: Cannot tell whether an agent (claude and such) is running in {{name}}’s terminal.

clockOut.title: Clock out
clockOut.warning: The running session will be terminated.
clockOut.warningAll: All running sessions will be terminated.
clockOut.bodyAll_one: Clock out the {{count}} character on duty?
clockOut.bodyAll_other: Clock out all {{count}} characters on duty?

quit.flushBody: Writing today’s work into diaries before quitting.
quit.flushBodyProgress: Writing today’s work into diaries before quitting ({{done}}/{{total}}).
quit.title: Confirm quit
quit.handoffBody: Terminals are running. You can quit and leave them running.
quit.body: Some agents have not clocked out. Quitting now stops every running session.
